Move OPS-013 to independent Review after implementation PR #139 was merged as 16070d0d0d4c1a4952d2fc6f036dda135f058c8d and its actual main was independently accepted. This PR changes only the task's own Program status, Active/Task phase metadata and Evidence; the active Program retains ISSUE-137/null until normal Completion. Original claims, roles, lease, capacity, other tasks, code and POC contracts are unchanged.

The exact source 6b8b7999e73a9a5fd7c8cf45bb04a6adee4a7c0d passed all 13 declared local metadata checks in a fresh native clone, with clean unchanged source/tree. Independent content reviews and actual implementation-main seven checks plus CI #837 (742 passed, zero test skips) are separately attributed. Preserve the rejected unpublished 997 proposal and 596 scope-format failure as historical evidence; their partial results do not qualify this source.

Current PR requires its own complete same-head hosted governance tests (expected 742), skip audit, independent final source review and fresh integration preflight before merge. This is not Completion or permission for OPS-014. Issue #137 remains open.

Evidence: evidence/OPS-013/
